description.value: Sunset View Campground occupies a developed section of Green Lake Park in the Cariboo, fronting a warm, shallow lake known for its striking greenish hue and sandy pebble beaches with roped swimming areas; the site is 16–18 km off the highway on secondary roads and the gate closes outside the operating season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is the official BC Parks page for Green Lake Park, which explicitly identifies Sunset View as one of five 'developed facilities' sites within the park intended for 'high levels of recreation.' The frontcountry camping reservation section on the site references booking via camping.bcparks.ca, applicable to this developed campground. OSM tags supply operator, capacity, and contact details; the community tag ('Okanagan & Thompson') conflicts with the website's 'Cariboo' designation, flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM community tag lists 'Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson' but the official BC Parks website places Green Lake Park in the Cariboo region — community categorization may be incorrect.

OSM phone (+1-250-320-9305) is attributed to operator Shuswap Adams Parks Ltd. but is not confirmed on the fetched website pages; only general BC Parks contact numbers (1-800-689-9025) appear in the website content.
No civic address is present in the OSM record; the website provides only directional access instructions (approx. 16 km northeast of 70 Mile House off Hwy #97).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Sunset View is a legitimate, active BC Parks developed campground with 54 capacity in a scenic lakeside setting; it is a clear fit for the WWC cycling tourism directory as a touring cyclist destination.
enrichment_extras.notes: A sani-station and BC Parks information shelter are located at the south end of the park per the website. Internet access confirmed unavailable (OSM tag internet_access=no). ORVs are explicitly prohibited within the park.
